name: homebridge-ai-kit
description: Control your Homebridge accessories and scenes, manage plugins and config, and read logs from Claude.
long_description:
Homebridge AI Kit is an MCP server for the Homebridge UI. It lists and controls accessories (locks, garage doors and alarms only after you confirm), runs and saves scenes, restarts the server and child bridges, edits config.json with diffs and backups, installs and updates plugins, and searches the logs.

**Setup:** enter your Homebridge UI address (for example `http://192.168.1.100:8581`) and either an API token (Homebridge Glass UI, `hbg_…`) or the UI username and password. Turn on **Read-only** to remove every tool that changes something.

Secrets in config.json are redacted in everything the server returns. For a self-signed `https` UI, paste its certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint.

homebridge_url.title: Homebridge UI URL
homebridge_url.description: Address of your Homebridge UI, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8581

homebridge_token.title: API token
homebridge_token.description: A Homebridge UI API token (Glass UI, hbg_…). Replaces the username and password.

homebridge_username.title: Username
homebridge_username.description: Homebridge UI login, when no API token is set.

homebridge_password.title: Password
homebridge_password.description: Homebridge UI password, when no API token is set.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Only reading tools: no device control, config changes, plugin installs or restarts.

cert_fingerprint.title: Certificate fingerprint
cert_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of a self-signed https Homebridge UI certificate to trust. Leave empty otherwise.
